messages:
Sophie: Hey @Alex — I pushed an iteration addressing your comments (split helper, added extra unit, tightened error wraps). PTAL when you have ~10–15m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/432
Alex: Thanks — will try before EOD. Anything particular you want eyeballs on?
Sophie: Mostly the allocator rotation change and the new public helper surface. I left inline comments tagged LOOK. Also added a tiny smoke script for local runs:
```bash
./scripts/smoke.sh --target=allocator --quick
```
Cheng: Quick heads-up: CI showed a mac-lint failure (missing newline in allocator_test.go:12). I pushed a one-line fix to the branch.
Sophie: Fixed it and pushed. Starting a CI rerun now.
CI-bot: CI pipeline started for branch sophie/fix-allocator (jobs: linux-build, linux-tests, mac-lint).
Alex: I left one comment about wrapping sentinel errors in the helper; that can be a follow-up if you want, but otherwise LGTM.
Maya: fyi I'm on call 15:00–17:00 PT today; if merge needs any manual rollback ping me in #eng-oncall.
Sophie: Understood — want to merge once CI is green so I can cut the canary tonight. If anyone has objections, say now :eyes: 
Alex: No objections. :+1:
Cheng: Looks fine to me. Small test tweak is reasonable.
CI-bot: mac-lint job passed. linux-tests: 214/214 ✅. All checks green.
Alex: Approved via GitHub. (also left a small docs nudge but not blocking)
Sophie: Adding a short approval comment here to satisfy the repo rule that approvals must be visible in-thread. @Maya can you click approve when you have a sec? tiny change.
Maya: Approved on GH — clicked the approve button. Good to go. :shipit: 
Sophie: Merging on green. Scheduling canary for tonight 22:00 PT. Thanks for the quick reviews all.
Deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-04-03T22:00:00-07:00 for release/canary-20250403 by user sophie.
Sophie: Tagging the canary branch as release/canary-20250403 and noting the change in the rollout playbook. If anything flaps tonight I'll open a rollback immediately and ping #incidents. Thanks!
